title: blockera-one/template-builder/catalog
description: Templates Builder variant catalog payload: template type → pool id → Variant[]. This file is the single source of truth for the child-theme catalog API. PHP validates each variant against the definitions below (dev mode only) and the JS hydrate layer must consume every variant key. Keep `definitions` fully inline (no nested $ref) — the PHP validator feeds them straight into rest_validate_value_from_schema(), which does not resolve $ref.

^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$.description: One template type (archive, single, home, …): pool id → ordered variant list. The first variant in a pool is the toggle-on default.

patternVariant.description: Variant whose markup is a registered block pattern, resolved at runtime from the core patterns store.

id.description: Kebab-case variant id; becomes the stamp variant ({role}/{poolId}:{id}).

kind.description: Variant kind; defaults to pattern when omitted.

patternSlug.description: Registered block pattern slug (namespace/name). Child themes overriding this exact slug restyle the variant; new slugs add tiles via the catalog filter.

thumbnail.description: Layout-picker thumbnail URL (theme file via get_theme_file_uri so child themes can override the file).

placement.description: Where the section lives when this design is applied (swap relocates, toggle-on inserts, transplant re-attaches here).

relativeTo.description: Stamp id the placement is relative to.

areas.description: Area stamp ids this layout variant exposes (content required by the area lint).

chromeLayout.description: Site chrome frame layout used by header/footer swaps.

templatePartVariant.description: Variant whose markup is a self-closing core/template-part reference (site header/footer chrome). JS builds the wp:template-part comment from slug/area/tagName.

id.description: Kebab-case variant id; becomes the stamp variant ({role}/{poolId}:{id}).

tagName.description: HTML tag for the rendered part (header, footer, aside, …).

thumbnail.description: Layout-picker thumbnail URL (theme file via get_theme_file_uri so child themes can override the file).

placement.description: Where the section lives when this design is applied (swap relocates, toggle-on inserts, transplant re-attaches here).

relativeTo.description: Stamp id the placement is relative to.

chromeLayout.description: Site chrome frame layout used by header/footer swaps.
